summary.warmupProcedure: 1 unmeasured execution per query to prime InnoDB buffer pool
summary.equivalenceVerificationMethod: Deterministic row-by-row sorting and JSON canonicalization comparison
summary.collationNote: The empirical collation experiment demonstrates a semantic divergence for the tested SARGable rewrite under different column collations (preserving results under utf8mb4_general_ci, but dropping mixed-case rows under utf8mb4_bin). It proves why heuristic SQL optimizers must not apply naive syntactic function-flattening without collation awareness.
summary.limitationNote: Evaluated on a local synthetic dataset (300 customers, 600 orders) on MySQL 8.0.46. Results reflect in-memory buffer pool operations and cannot be generalized to multi-gigabyte disk-bound workloads.
